description: Defines classes and methods for establishing SSL connections, including SSL socket parameters and the SSL connection job, within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: SSLSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for SSL socket connections, including connection type and proxy settings.

classes.name: SSLConnectJob
classes.description: Manages establishing an SSL connection, including proxy handling and SSL handshake, within Chromium's network stack.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an SSLConnectJob instance.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the connection attempt.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Indicates whether the connection has been successfully established.

methods.name: OnConnectJobComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a sub-job.

methods.name: GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of connection attempts made.

methods.name: IsSSLError
methods.description: Determines if the error is SSL-related.

methods.name: HandshakeTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for SSL handshake, used in testing.
